title: Reduced Monthly Withholding from VA Benefit Payments — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Contact Center Reference
content:
## Situation of use and capability

Reduced withholding starts on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** with its approved monthly amount, and its first month is the calendar month after the month in which it starts.

Reduced withholding does not start on a debt until the debt carries a reduced-withholding request received on the day it starts.

In the same terms: reduced withholding begins only where the debt's records hold a reduced-withholding request dated the day it begins.

The withholding tool starts, on a verified caller's behalf, reduced monthly withholding from VA benefit payments on one debt. One call puts the debt into repayment-plan status with the payment method set to benefit withholding, and records the approved monthly withholding and the first withholding month on the debt; from then on each monthly benefit payment is withheld only that amount. The balance is not changed.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `start_reduced_withholding_20dc00ef`. The representative unlocks it and calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `debt_id` | The reference number of the VA debt, as shown on the debt record returned by the debt lookup for this debtor | Identifier text |
| `monthly_amount` | The approved monthly withholding, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, stored rounded half-to-even to the cent; passed at cent precision |
| `start_month` | The first month of reduced withholding | Written YYYY-MM |

## Return

A successful call echoes the terms now on the debt: `debt_id`, `status` (always "repayment_plan"; this status means the reduced withholding is in effect), `repayment_plan_method` (always "benefit_withholding"), `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `repayment_plan_start_month` (YYYY-MM).

## Hypothetical illustration

Reduced withholding that starts on 5 June 2027 has its first month in July 2027 (`start_month` 2027-07); the debt then shows repayment-plan status, benefit withholding as the method, and the approved monthly withholding.
